bias.en: Rebound · SAR flipped bullish, above the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 转为看多，站上 10 日均线

read.en: Corning rose 7.4% on Nov 11 to $120.46, trading $116.50–123.87. It is above the 5-day ($111.6) and 10-day ($117.8) and below the 30-day ($134.8), 100-day ($155.8) and 200-day ($156.5); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 11 ($101.83), and RSI is 44.1.
read.zh: 康宁 11月11日上涨 7.4%，收于 $120.46，盘中区间 $116.50–123.87。股价位于 5 日（$111.6）和 10 日均线（$117.8）上方，30 日（$134.8）、100 日（$155.8）和 200 日均线（$156.5）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图接近收拢（临近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 于 11月11日转为看多（$101.83），RSI 为 44.1。

read.en: The rally reclaimed $114.2–115.6 and cleared the $116.5 Nov 9 high and the 10-day, now support; the $123.87 high stopped at $123.2–123.8 (Nov 2 close, Nov 4 high). Resistance is $123.2–123.9, then $126.1–129.9 (Nov 3 close, Nov 2–3 highs) and $134.8 (30-day). Support is $116.5–117.8, then $114.2–115.6 and $110–111.6. A close above $123.9 would target $126–130; below $116.5, $114–115.6.
